delocation.reason: Current Homebrew-linked NetCDF/HDF5 compression libraries require macOS 15.0; delocate rejected lowering the wheel target to 11.0.

resolution: Do not distribute the raw macosx_11_0 wheel. The failed local attempt used prebuilt Homebrew dylibs; the repository workflow rebuilds these dependencies from source with the declared target, but that CI path has not run. A separate macosx_15_0 wheel from the same source passed isolated installation, Mach-O audit, and four-format readback; see rust-migration-packaging.json.
status_note: macOS 11 compatibility of the source-built workflow remains unverified. This report only establishes that current prebuilt Homebrew dylibs cannot be relabeled as macOS 11.
